description: Download one file by md5. Streams to disk with a size cap, verifies the file against its LibGen md5, and never overwrites an existing file unless overwrite=true. Returns the saved path, byte count and verification result.

downloadDir.description: Directory to save into. Defaults to LIBGEN_DOWNLOAD_DIR or the process cwd.

md5.description: LibGen md5 of the file (32 hex characters), from a search result.

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing file instead of adding a numeric suffix.

verifyMd5.description: Verify the downloaded file's MD5. Defaults to true.

name: libgen_download
title: Download a book
